title: Gas Geyser vs Instant Electric Geyser 2026: Units Consumption, K-Electric Protected Slabs & Bill Bachat Formula
excerpt: Sardion mein gas load-shedding ke dauran Instant Electric Geyser kitne units khata hai? 200 units protected slab ko mehfooz rakh kar mahana Rs 5,000+ bijli ka bill bachane ka mukammal hisab.
author: Read Meter Energy Analytics Team
content:
## Sardion Ka Sab Se Barha Kharcha: Geyser Bijli Ka Bill Kitna Barhata Hai?

Pakistan mein sardiyan aate hi gas ki shadeed load-shedding aur low pressure ka masla shuru ho jata hai. Har saal hazaron gharelu sarfeen (domestic consumers) gas geysers ke na chalne ki wajah se **Instant Electric Geyser** ya **Storage Electric Geyser** khareedne par majboor ho jatay hain.

Lekin sab se barha shock December aur January ke bijli ke bill mein lagta hai! Jo ghar garmiyon ke baad 180–190 units par chal raha tha, geyser aate hi achanak **320 se 380 units** par chala jata hai, aur bill **Rs 3,200 se seedha Rs 14,000+** cross kar jata hai.

Is article mein hum live mathematical calculations ke zariye samjhayenge ke:
1. Instant Electric Geyser vs Conventional Storage Geyser kitne units lete hain.
2. Ek 15 minute ke shower ki bijli ki qeemat kitni hoti hai.
3. 200 units Protected Slab ko geyser ke dauran kaise bachana hai.
4. Sardion mein bill 50% kam karne ke 4 practical tareeqay.

---

## 1. Electric Geysers Ki Types Aur Unki Wattage

Market mein bunyadi taur par 2 tarah ke electric geysers milte hain:

### A. Instant Electric Geyser (3kW se 5kW):
- **Kaisay kaam karta hai:** Is mein storage tank nahi hota. Jaise hi tap open karte hain, high-wattage heating element paani ko foran garam karta hai.
- **Wattage:** Aam taur par **3,000 Watts (3 kW) se 5,000 Watts (5 kW)**.
- **Unit Rate:** 1 ghanta musalsal chalne par yeh **3 se 5 units** consume karta hai.

### B. Storage Electric Geyser (1.5kW se 2.5kW):
- **Kaisay kaam karta hai:** 30 se 50 liters ka tank hota hai jismein paani garam rehne ke liye thermostat musalsal on-off hota rehta hai.
- **Wattage:** **1,500 Watts (1.5 kW) se 2,000 Watts (2 kW)**.
- **Hidden Trap:** Agar iska switch 24 ghante on chorein to standby heat loss ki wajah se yeh rozana **6 se 8 units** be-wajah zaya karta hai!

---

## 2. Real Calculations: Ek Mahine Mein Geyser Ke Units Ka Hisab

Farz karein 4 ya 5 afrad ka ek aam Pakistani gharana hai jahan rozana kul milakar **45 minutes** geyser ka garam paani istemal hota hai:

| Geyser Type | Power Rating | Rozana Istemal (Time) | Rozana Units | Mahana Units (30 Din) | Mahana Izafi Bill (Unprotected Rate) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Instant Geyser (Fast)** | 3.5 kW | 45 mins (0.75 hrs) | **2.6 Units** | **~78 Units** | **~Rs 3,200 – Rs 3,800** |
| **Storage Geyser (Timer ke sath)** | 2.0 kW | 1.5 hrs heating | **3.0 Units** | **~90 Units** | **~Rs 3,700 – Rs 4,400** |
| **Storage Geyser (24/7 ON)** | 2.0 kW | 4.5 hrs cycling | **9.0 Units** | **~270 Units** | **~Rs 11,500 – Rs 13,000! ⚡** |

> ⚠️ **Sabaq:** Agar aap storage geyser ka button 24 ghante on rakhte hain to sirf geyser ka bill aap ke pure ghar ke bill se doguna ho sakta hai!

---

## 3. 200 Units Protected Slab Ka Khatra (Cliff Effect)

NEPRA ke qawaneen ke mutabiq agar aap ka monthly consumption **200 units** tak rehta hai to aap protected consumer hain (Bill: ~Rs 3,000 - Rs 3,500).

Agar aap normal lights, fridge aur fans se **160 units** par chal rahe thay, aur sardion mein 3.5 kW instant geyser lagakar sirf **50 units** mazeed consume kar liye:

* **Total Units:** 160 + 50 = **210 Units**
* **Protected Status:** ❌ CANCELLED (Aap non-protected slab mein gir gaye!)
* **Bill Impact:** Pehle unit se 210th unit tak ka rate barh kar ~Rs 38/unit ho jata hai, sath FPA aur GST lagti hai.
* **Bill Jump:** Rs 3,200 se seedha **Rs 8,900+** (Sirf 10 units threshold cross karne par Rs 5,700 ka seedha nuqsan).
* **6 Months Penalty:** Aglay 6 maheenon tak aap ko protected rate wapis nahi milega!

---

## 4. Sardion Mein Bill Bachane Ke 4 Smart Hacks

1. **Geyser Ko K-Electric Peak Hours Mein Hargiz Na Chalayein:**
   - Sardion ke peak hours (shaam **5:00 PM se 9:00 PM**) ke dauran bijli ka unit rate 40% tak mehanga hota hai. Geyser hamesha subah 7:00 AM se 10:00 AM ke darmiyan chalayein.

2. **Thermostat Temperature 45°C–50°C Par Set Karein:**
   - Aksar geysers default taur par 65°C–70°C par set hote hain. Isay 45°C–50°C par set karne se bijli ki consumption 25% foran drop ho jati hai aur paani nahane ke liye perfect rehta hai.

3. **Smart Plug / Mechanical Timer Lagayein:**
   - Storage geyser ke liye bazaar se Rs 1,500 ka mechanical timer switch lagayein jo rozana subah sirf 45 minutes on ho aur phir auto cut-off kar de.

4. **Daily Meter Tracking (Read Meter PWA):**
   - Sardion mein har hafte [Read Meter (readmeter.online)](https://www.readmeter.online) par apne electricity meter ki camera photo capture karein. App aap ko 200 units cross hone se pehle hi alert kar degi taake aap timely geyser ka istemal control kar sakein.

---

## Summary & Conclusion

Electric geyser sardion ki zaroorat zaroor hai, lekin be-ehtiyati aap ka gharelu budget hila sakti hai. 24 ghante switch on rakhne ke bajaye sirf zaroorat ke waqt on karein, peak hours se bachein, aur daily units track karein taake protected slab mehfooz rahe.

faqs.question: Instant geyser ziada bijli khata hai ya storage geyser?
faqs.answer: Instant geyser ka wattage ziada hota hai (3kW–5kW) lekin yeh sirf utni der chalta hai jitni der nalka khula ho. Agar storage geyser ko 24 ghante on rakha jaye to standby heat loss ki wajah se storage geyser 3 guna ziada bijli khata hai. Timer ke sath chalaya jaye to dono taqreeban barabar units lete hain.

faqs.question: Kya 15 minute ke shower se protected slab toot sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Agar aap 5kW instant geyser 15 minute chalate hain to rozana taqreeban 1.25 units kharch hote hain (mahina 38 units). Agar aap pehle hi 170–180 units par thay, to yeh 38 units aap ko 200 ki had se paar karwa kar non-protected category mein daal denge.

faqs.question: Geyser chalane ka sab se sasta waqt kon sa hai?
faqs.answer: Subah 6:00 AM se 11:00 AM ke darmiyan grid par normal off-peak rate hota hai. Shaam 5:00 PM se 9:00 PM ke peak hours mein geyser chalane se sakhti se parhez karein.
